Also: Aquestive Q2-2026 10-Q balance sheet (filed 2026-08-11), HF/PK results PR (2026-08-10), Schubert Jonckheer investor alert (PRNewswire, 2026-10-07), and FMP quote of 2026-10-12.
verified.analysis: Verified: Aquestive resubmitted the Anaphylm NDA on 2026-09-17 after positive human-factors and PK data on 08-10. The FDA has not yet announced the resubmission class or a PDUFA date, so the 'Q1-2027 PDUFA' is an inference, not a dated fact. Capital structure (10-Q as of 2026-06-30): no preferred stock, cash $98.5M, long-term debt about $50.7M, about $95M of other non-current liabilities (likely royalty financing), stockholders' equity -$56.6M. The equity waterfall can carry an approval re-rate, but the royalty overhang means the event's upside is not fully the common holders'. This is an early-arc, unrun binary: keep it on WATCH and upgrade if the acceptance letter confirms Class 2 with a dated PDUFA. Gap: web search was unavailable (budget used up), so I could not confirm the content of the original CRL, the exact royalty terms, or whether the 37% drop came from the CRL or a later disclosure.

G1 is weak: Apollo is the manager and the counterparty for the trust, not the buyer of the remaining assets.

Before the June 15 strategic-review and $3.75 dividend announcement the stock was about $11 with the $3.75 attached, roughly $7.25 ex-dividend; it now sits at $6.24, a 52-week low area. Remaining: +24% to +36% to the guided $7.75-8.50 total. Measured on the stub, that is +71% to +106% ($2.14 vs $3.65-4.40) over about 1.6 years, an IRR of about 14-21% if guidance holds. verified.primary_source: ARI DEFM14A filed 2026-08-24 (sec.gov 0001193125-26-363807), Estimated Total Stockholder Distributions Range of $7.75-8.50. GlobeNewswire 2026-10-09, initial $4.10 liquidating distribution. FMP quote 2026-10-12, $6.24.
verified.analysis: The numerator is re-derived from the company's own DEFM14A (2026-08-24), not an analyst target. The $7.75-8.50/sh fully diluted range includes the initial distribution and excludes the $3.75 July 15 dividend. It is net of the board-approved redemption of the 7.25% Series B-1 preferred, so no preferred stock is senior to the common in this figure. Wind-up costs are estimated through H1 2028, and the trust fee is a reduced 0.50% of net assets, a modest leak for an external manager. The $4.10 is above the $3.70-4.00 the market had expected, which suggests conservative guidance, yet the stock has fallen from $6.84 (Sep 2) to $6.24. The market is pricing the residual REO at roughly 50-60% of management's implied value; that is the bet, and it has no hard dates beyond Oct 29. Gaps: the web search budget was exhausted, so the 9/29 approval 8-K text and the Q2 10-Q REO carrying values per asset were not read directly; the inference that approval happened rests on the liquidating distribution being declared.
